turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: sergeant at arms is directed to make a proclamation.

turns.speaker: Alfredo Sotto Corpuz
turns.text: All persons are commanded to keep silent under pain of penalty while the impeachment court is in session for the trial of Vice President Sara Zimmerman Duterte.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: The impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Zimmerman Duterte is hereby called to order. We shall be led in prayer by Senator-Judge Vicente C. Sotto III.

turns.speaker: Sen. Vicente C. Sotto III
turns.text: Almighty and merciful God, we come before you with humility as our nation enters a solemn and consequential moment in the impeachment proceedings.

turns.speaker: Sen. Vicente C. Sotto III
turns.text: We pray that you guide every person entrusted with this constitutional process, especially each senator who will sit as a judge. Grant us who are gathered in this august chamber integrity, good faith, courage, and sound judgment. Keep our hearts free from political pressure, personal interests, prejudice, anger, and fear. May we seek not what is convenient or popular, but what is right. Just and faithful to the truth. Dear Lord Father God, remind each of us that our duty is not to any individual, party, or faction. Our duty is to you, to the Filipino people, and to the Constitution. Give us the wisdom to weigh the evidence carefully, the fairness to listen with an open mind, and the courage to make decisions according to our conscience and the law. May truth prevail over rumor, facts over speculation, and justice over politics. Let every proceeding be conducted with dignity, fairness and respect for the rule of law. Dear Lord, protect our country from division and hatred. Give our people patience, discernment, and faith in the proper institutions of our republic. May your wisdom guide us, may your justice lead us, and may your truth prevail. Amen.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Amen. The clerk of court will now call the roll.

turns.speaker: Atty. Renato N. Bantug Jr.
turns.text: Call call up members. At hindi ho nire-require, Your Honor, na kailangan ho namin mag-stipulate on the exhibits, on the authenticity, so that they can use Rule 130, Section 7. And if properly done po, Your Honor, I think they can identify or they can finish all one quarter in less than 10 minutes. I'm talking about that, no? I'm talking about that based on experience. So, Your Honor, we don't object to their Implementation of Rule 130, Section 7 as to the manner by how they will do it. We will also not object but subject to cross-examination, Your Honor. turns.text: Maraming salamat po, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Chiz” Escudero
turns.text: Thank you very much. There will be no other business to attend to and to take up and discuss. Trial is hereby adjourned until tomorrow, August 12 at 10 am.
